prompt: The client wants to know what is driving its revenue growth. Which takeaway matters most?

options.text: Growth comes from new customers, not higher spend per customer
options.feedback: Right. Customers grew 72% (50k to 86k) and revenue 60% (100 to 160), so revenue per customer fell from about $2,000 to $1,860.
True, but it doesn't answer the client's question.

options.text: The number of customers fell in 2025
options.feedback: That misreads the chart: Customers rose every year, from 50k to 86k.

options.text: Marketing spend drove the new customers, which is why growth has held up
options.feedback: The chart doesn't show this. It may be true, but there is no data here to support it.

explanation: Growth comes from new customers, not higher spend per customer. Customers grew 72% (50k to 86k) and revenue 60% (100 to 160), so revenue per customer fell from about $2,000 to $1,860.
